Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. A few answers and clarifications from FinCo's side: 

- SOC 2: We require SOC 2 Type II evidence covering production inference, data-at-rest, and access controls. We currently expect to complete our vendor review by end of Q1 2027, so earlier evidence is preferred.

- Questionnaire: I attached a partially completed Vendor Security Questionnaire with our comments. Please review and complete the sections for encryption, key management, and incident response; Rishi's input will be helpful for the technical sections.

- GDPR/HIPAA: We operate in the EU for some regulated customers and have HIPAA-covered data flows for a subset of use cases. Key items for us: data residency (EU data centers), encryption in transit and at rest, and BAA options if required.

- ISO / FedRAMP: ISO 27001 certification would be a strong plus; FedRAMP is a longer-term requirement for some of our federal contracts — we understand this is a bigger program.

Attached: FinCo_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_filled.xlsx

Can Rishi send a short tech memo addressing: encryption at rest (algorithms/keys), KMS options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed), audit log retention and access controls? If we can get that by Thu EOD, we'll schedule a walkthrough for next week.

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:45 AM Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@finco.com> wrote:
> Can Rishi send a short tech memo addressing: encryption at rest (algorithms/keys), KMS options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed), audit log retention and access controls?

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks for the details. Quick technical summary below (I can expand to a 1–2 page memo and attach to the questionnaire):

- Encryption at rest: AES-256 is used across persistent storage. Full-disk and object-store encryption in all supported cloud regions.
- KMS: We support both Redwood-managed keys (default) and customer-managed keys via customer KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS). For customer-managed KMS we can configure envelope encryption so keys never leave your control.
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers.
- Access controls / audit logs: RBAC for console/API, integration with customer SSO (SAML/OIDC). Audit logs for control-plane and admin actions retained for 13 months by default; longer retention is available as an add-on. Logs can be exported to customer log sinks (CloudWatch, Stackdriver, Splunk).
- SOC 2 scope: Our current SOC 2 Type II (last attestation 2025) covered core control plane and hosted inference paths. We are in the process of expanding scope to include dedicated/reserved capacity in a planned 2026 re-audit — I will confirm schedule and provide a timeline by Thu.
- ISO27001 / FedRAMP: ISO 27001 kickoff is planned for H2 2027 (program level), so formal certification is not yet available. FedRAMP is exploratory and would be a multi-year program; feel free to mark as longer-term.

I'll prepare the short tech memo and map answers to the questionnaire fields you attached. Target: Thu EOD.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
